subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>：顾砚辞，17 岁中国男高中生，发型以参考图为准，服装以参考图为准，内搭白衬衫，系藏青色细条纹领带，黑色长裤，黑色皮鞋。完全参照 <Picture 1> 外观。<Picture 1> 不得展示纯白背景，实际场景替换为高二三班教室。
<Subject 2>：夏小满，16 岁中国女高中生，发型以参考图为准，戴细银色小圆环耳饰，服装以参考图为准，内搭白色T恤，蓝白色运动长裤，服装以参考图为准。完全参照 <Picture 2> 外观。<Picture 2> 不得展示纯白背景，实际场景替换为高二三班教室。
<Subject 3>：高二三班教室，阳光透过大窗户洒进室内，木质课桌椅成排，桌面摊开纸质笔记本和一支钢笔，窗外隐约可见操场，清新暖色调自然光。无参考图，由文字描述定义。

summary:
[reference generation] 12 秒四镜头，场景是高二三班教室。顾砚辞低头用钢笔在笔记本上写字，夏小满翻开自己的笔记偷看他的字迹并轻声赞叹，顾砚辞抬眼与她视线相撞，最后镜头定格在笔记本工整字迹与她目光的倒影上。镜头依次用中景推近、侧脸近景、面部近景、俯视特写完成正反打，整体是电影感真人摄影、35mm 镜头质感、浅景深、清新暖色调自然柔光。两张参考图仅定义两位主角外观，只作生成指导，不作帧锚。

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - 他的发型与服装以参考图为准，全程不变。动作：执笔低头写字 → 笔尖停在纸面 → 抬眼撞上她的视线 → 目光落回纸面。
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], 发型与服装以参考图为准。动作：翻开笔记偷看 → 盯着字迹轻声赞叹 → 目光投在纸面倒影上。
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - 高二三班教室（阳光窗户、木质课桌、笔记本与钢笔）作为连续环境贯穿全片。
画面里只有顾砚辞和夏小满两个人，绝对没有其它人。

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic live-action Chinese campus youth scene with a cinematic 35mm lens feel, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural window light, true-to-life skin texture, and no subtitles, watermarks, or borders anywhere in the frame.
[Shot 1] The scene opens in <Subject 3>, the sunlit classroom of Class 3, Grade 11, in the morning. A medium shot frames <Subject 1> on frame left, head lowered, writing in an open notebook with a pen, and <Subject 2> on frame right at the next desk. <Subject 2> flips open her own notebook and sneaks a glance at his handwriting, her fingertips pressing the page corner flat. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the two desks. A soft page-flipping sound accompanies her movement.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2> in profile, frame right. She stares at the neat handwriting in the notebook, her eyebrows lifting slightly, her eyes brightening as the pupils catch the window light, the corners of her mouth slowly rising. The camera keeps pushing in with small amplitude at slow speed toward her profile. She whispers in a clear, soft teenage girl voice (S1), [中文] "你字好好看。" After the line her lips press together gently into a small smile, her breathing staying light and even.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>, frame left. He lifts his eyes from the page and meets her gaze, his eyebrows raising slightly in mild surprise, the pen tip stopping on the paper with a faint scratch. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed to his face. He holds the glance for a beat, then lowers his eyes back to the page, the pen still resting motionless between his fingers.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to an overhead close-up, looking straight down at the open notebook, where neat rows of handwritten characters fill the page, the pen lying in the gutter. <Subject 2>'s eyes are reflected faintly on the paper surface as she leans in. The camera holds a static overhead shot with tiny natural drift. A soft paper rustle rises at the end, preparing the transition to the next shot, and the frame settles on the page and her reflected gaze.

overall_soundscape:
安静的教室环境底噪，窗外隐约的操场人声，纸张翻动声，笔尖写字与停笔的细微沙沙声。

non_diegetic_music:
轻柔的木吉他与钢琴，慢速，力度轻，在 [Shot 2] 处轻微上扬后于 [Shot 3] 回落，无明显高潮。

Negative: no other people, no text, no watermark, no subtitles, no borders, no exaggerated expression, no camera shake,
